Ensure that any spotlights that are installed are of the energy efficient types. Options include compact fluroescents (CFL), LED's and efficient 12 volt dichroic lights. Typically a 50W halogen lamp will cost around £15 a year to to run, a Xenon filled 35W Dichroic will cost £10.5 a year to run, whereas an 11W CFL costs £3-4 a year to run and a 5W LED spotlight with the same light output as a 50W lamp will cost £1.5-£2 a year to run
